name: AI Chatbot & Live Chat for WooCommerce: Emporiqa
author: Rosen Hristov

sections.description:
The first 50 WooCommerce stores get $100 of credit instead of $25, about 400 conversations. Connect your store, then send us your store name and we add the credit. No card needed.

Emporiqa is an AI shop assistant for sales and support, in the chat on your WooCommerce store and in your shop’s customer emails, working with your team: a person can take over any chat. There is no monthly fee and no API key to paste. You pay $0.25 per conversation and $0.15 per AI-drafted email reply you send, and nothing in the months it isn’t used. The AI model cost is inside those rates, so no second bill arrives. You start with $25 of signup credit, about 100 conversations, once, and no card is required.

It helps shoppers choose and answers their support questions, in 65 languages, from your own synced catalog.

Open the live demo store and ask for a product it does not sell: it says so instead of inventing one. That demo sells electronics; on your store it answers from your own catalog, whatever you sell. On a cosmetics shop, “a fragrance-free moisturiser for sensitive skin” brings back only the creams your catalog lists as fragrance-free.

What it does

  • Recommends by meaning, not keyword: “waterproof winter boots under 80, size 9” returns only what matches all four conditions
  • Over budget? It shows cheaper alternatives you already sell, and when the size or colour is unclear, it asks
  • Visual search: finds the closest thing you stock from a photo a shopper uploads
  • Voice mode, if you switch it on: the shopper taps the microphone, speaks, and hears the answer read aloud while the product cards stay on screen
  • Adds the item to the WooCommerce cart, with your own stock and variation checks
  • Answers shipping, returns and policy questions from your synced pages
  • Order tracking in the chat: looks up an order from a number and email (a shopper signed in to your store gives only the number)
  • Shows a signed-in customer the price WooCommerce calculates for them, role and wholesale prices included, greets them by first name, and passes their name and email to your team instead of asking
  • Ready-made rules under Settings > Rules in Emporiqa also pass returns, cancellations, order changes, quotes and invoice requests to your team
  • Lets anyone on your team take over a live conversation, reading it from the first message with your saved replies to hand
  • Alerts your team in Slack, Microsoft Teams, Discord, Google Chat or email; outside your business hours it takes an email or phone number
  • Reports which chats ended in a purchase, with the revenue attributed to chat
  • Customer emails: drafts replies to your shop’s customer emails from your catalog and pages; your team checks and sends each draft from your own address, and automatic replies stay off until you switch them on
  • Put the chat on your pages: the Settings tab gives a question link, a chat link and a chat page to paste into product descriptions, pages and menus; nothing changes on your storefront until you paste one

Answers and wording you control

Write your own answers as pages in the Emporiqa dashboard, up to 25 per store and 10 languages each, and a sync from your shop never touches them.

Under Settings and How the chat writes, pick one of four tones, Standard, Friendly, Professional or Concise, and leave short wording notes, in general and per situation. That changes wording only: stock, prices and orders come from your store, and “never say something is out of stock” is ignored on purpose.

Under Settings and Widget appearance, add up to four starter questions per language, shown as buttons under the welcome message until the conversation starts, and put your store’s own picture in the chat header and next to the chat’s answers. Team members can answer under their own name and photo.

Customer emails

Connect your shop’s mailbox in Emporiqa (Gmail, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Outlook.com, IONOS, Strato, OVHcloud or any IMAP mailbox) and Emporiqa drafts each reply from your catalog and pages, in the customer’s language. Order details in drafts, and automatic replies, work on Gmail, Google Workspace and Microsoft (Outlook.com and Microsoft 365). Automatic replies are off until you switch them on. They cover only topics your team has already answered many times without changing the draft, and each waits 10 minutes so anyone can stop it. Every other reply is a draft your team checks and sends from your own address. Emporiqa never refunds, cancels or changes an order. How customer emails work

The chat tells shoppers it is an AI

The default greeting tells the shopper they are talking to your store’s AI assistant, in every language the chat speaks, which is the disclosure the EU AI Act asks for. If you rewrite the greeting, keep that disclosure in it: one that drops it is refused when you save, and the Emporiqa terms (section 8.6) treat removing it, including through custom CSS or code, as a breach.

Built for WooCommerce

Simple, variable, grouped and external products. HPOS. WPML and Polylang. Multi-currency via WOOCS, WPML Multi-Currency, WooCommerce Payments and Aelia.

Price, stock and status changes reach Emporiqa as you make them; a few edits need one Sync All afterwards, which the documentation covers. The same AI shop assistant also runs on Drupal Commerce, Magento, PrestaShop, Shopware and Sylius.

Privacy and security notes

The signed-in shopper’s token is fetched from admin-ajax.php?action=emporiqa_customer_token. It is read-only and returns only the current session’s own identity token. It cannot be nonce-protected, because the page that would carry the nonce is full-page cached; cross-site use is blocked instead by a required custom header (which forces a CORS preflight) and a Sec-Fetch-Site / Origin check, and the answer is never cached.

Third-Party Service

This plugin requires an Emporiqa account and sends data there. Your catalog and synced pages go to https://emporiqa.com/webhooks/sync/, signed with HMAC-SHA256; the widget script loads from https://emporiqa.com/chat/embed/; connecting uses a PKCE handshake via https://emporiqa.com/connect/start. What a shopper types, and any photo uploaded for visual search, is processed by Emporiqa’s AI provider and never trains AI models. If you switch on voice mode, a shopper’s spoken message goes to that provider to be turned into text and the reply is read aloud by an AI voice; Emporiqa does not keep the recording. Sync requests carry the plugin version (X-Emporiqa-Plugin-Version). If you add the Order status rule, Emporiqa calls this site’s /wp-json/emporiqa/v1/actions/order-status with a signed request to look up the order a shopper asks about; once the shopper has proved the order is theirs, the answer carries that order’s status, tracking, items, totals, payment and shipping method, and the names and addresses on it (never the email). When a shopper is signed in to your store, the chat sends Emporiqa their WordPress user ID (signed, never their name or email), so Order status can find their own orders without an email, /wp-json/emporiqa/v1/actions/customer-prices can answer with the prices your shop gives that customer, and /wp-json/emporiqa/v1/actions/customer-info can answer with that customer’s account name and email and their 10 newest orders (number, date, status, total; never addresses, phone or anyone else’s orders). Emporiqa also calls /wp-json/emporiqa/v1/actions/verify to check the address is yours. Each of these answers only a request signed with your store’s connection secret (HMAC-SHA256, within 5 minutes), checked by the route’s permission callback; the one unsigned call is the connect check, answered only during a connection you started in the last 2 minutes. Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Plugins > Add New, search for “Emporiqa”, then Install Now and Activate.
  2. Settings > Emporiqa, click Connect to Emporiqa, sign in or create a free account and pick the store. You land back connected.
  3. On the Sync tab, click Send my catalog. The widget appears once that first sync finishes.

On plain HTTP, or to paste credentials yourself, expand I’d rather paste credentials manually and use the Store ID and Connection Secret from Settings > Integration > Integration overview.

You can also set it up from Claude or ChatGPT: connect your assistant and it creates your store, sets up the chat and walks you through the install (how to connect it). You install the plugin yourself.

Full guide: emporiqa.com/docs/woocommerce/
sections.faq:
How do I get the $100 credit?

The first 50 WooCommerce stores that ask get $100 of credit instead of the standard $25, about 400 conversations. Install the plugin, connect your store, then send us your store name and we add the credit to your account. It is one per store, it needs no card, and places go in the order requests arrive. When all 50 are taken, new stores get the standard $25.

Is this AI shop assistant free?

The plugin is free and you connect without a card. The service is pay-as-you-go: $25 of signup credit, about 100 conversations, once ($100 for the first 50 WooCommerce stores that ask), then $0.25 per conversation and $0.15 per AI-drafted email reply you send. There is no monthly plan. New stores start with a $199 monthly limit, a ceiling on a month’s charges, not a fee, and you raise, lower or remove it yourself; you get an email at 80% and 100%. A month with 40 conversations costs $10. Team members are included with no per-seat fee, and a conversation is billed once, when the shopper first writes. Voice mode is optional and off by default: a conversation where the shopper speaks costs $0.15 more, charged once, and counts toward the same limit. Prices exclude VAT. Full pricing.

Do I need an OpenAI API key or my own AI account?

No. You do not open an account with an AI provider, paste a key, or manage tokens. The model cost is inside the per-conversation price.

What happens when the credit runs out?

You get an email before it is exhausted. If no card is on file by then the chat is hidden from your shop: your store keeps working, and the chat comes back when you add a card. At your monthly limit the same happens, and charging stops.

What will it cost at my traffic level?

Cost follows traffic, not revenue: multiply the conversations you expect by $0.25, and the email replies you send by $0.15. The share of visitors who open a chat varies by store, so you find your own figure in the first weeks. As an illustration, if 3 in 100 visitors opened the chat, 40,000 monthly visitors would come to roughly 1,200 conversations, about $300.

What happens when the chat can’t answer, or gets something wrong?

Ask for something you don’t stock and it says so, instead of inventing a product. Prices, stock, variations and policy pages come from what your site syncs. When it can’t answer with confidence it says so and offers to bring in a person. Every conversation is readable in the dashboard, and low-rated ones are flagged.

How is this different from a live chat plugin?

Live chat routes a shopper to a person, so it answers when someone is at the keyboard. This one answers on its own from your catalog and your pages, recommends and compares products, and your team can still take over any conversation.

Which languages does it speak?

65, and it answers in the language the shopper writes in. On multilingual stores it detects Polylang and WPML and syncs every configured language.

Will it work with my theme, and will it slow my site down?

It works with any theme: the widget is a script layered over your storefront, not built into it. The script loads asynchronously in the footer, and the chat downloads only when a shopper opens the bubble. It sits outside your checkout, so if Emporiqa is unreachable your storefront keeps working.

What do you do with my data, and my customers’ data?

Emporiqa is an EU company under GDPR, and shopper conversations are not used to train AI models. Your catalog stays in WooCommerce. There is no SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification and no service level agreement on pay-as-you-go. Rosen Hristov, who builds Emporiqa, works with every store himself, before and after the sale.

Can I add my own order details to Order status?

Yes. The emporiqa_order_status_data filter runs after the plugin has filled the answer, so you can change any value or put your own fields under extra (up to 30 keys, text up to 500 characters):

add_filter( 'emporiqa_order_status_data', function ( $data, $order ) { $data['extra']['pickup_point'] = $order->get_meta( '_pickup_point_name' ); return $data; }, 10, 2 );

Can I change what the chat learns about a signed-in customer?

Yes. The emporiqa_customer_info_data filter runs after the plugin has filled the customer’s name, email and newest orders, so you can remove a value or add your own fields under extra:

add_filter( 'emporiqa_customer_info_data', function ( $data, $user ) { unset( $data['customer']['email'] ); $data['extra']['loyalty_points'] = (int) get_user_meta( $user->ID, 'loyalty_points', true ); return $data; }, 10, 2 );

How do I turn the chat off, and what happens to my data?

Deactivate the plugin and the widget disappears from your storefront immediately, with no contract to cancel. Your synced products stay on the Emporiqa side until you delete the store there. Chat history is deleted after 90 days on a rolling basis, and there is no conversation export yet, so save any transcripts first.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • New: a “Put the chat on your pages” section on the Settings tab, folded by default and shown once your store is connected. It has three snippets to copy into your pages: a question link that opens your AI shop assistant with the question, a link that opens the chat, and a chat page that shows the chat inside the page. It says where to paste them and when a question is sent straight away. The plugin adds nothing to your storefront by itself.

1.2.5

  • Changed: the Connect screen and the Sync log no longer ask you to press Go live in your Emporiqa dashboard. The chat appears on your storefront once the first sync finishes.
  • Text only. No functional changes.

Older entries are in changelog.txt, shipped with the plugin.

Recommendations from your catalog: two laptops for photo editing, the reason for each, and a question back
Asked for a product the shop does not stock, it says so and asks what the shopper came in for
In-chat cart: the shopper names the colour, it adds that variant and offers checkout
Return questions answered from your shop's return policy, with a link to the full page
A teammate can step into the chat: the shopper asks for a person and your team replies in the same chat
Order status: given an order number and the matching email, it answers with the order card: status, date, items and total
Settings: connect your store to Emporiqa in one click
Sync tab: send your catalog in one click, sync products and pages in bulk, and test the connection
